signal.title: Open Sourcing π 0
signal.summary: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。

editorial.intro: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。
editorial.why_it_matters: 高质量仿真能够降低真实机器人试错成本，但关键在于生成环境是否保留了任务和物理约束。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对仿真与真实环境之间的差距，以及是否能复现到真实机器人。

evidence.excerpt: Open Sourcing π0 Physical Intelligence (π) Home Research Join Us Open Sourcing π 0 Published February 4, 2025 Email research@physicalintelligence.company Physical Intelligence Repo Physical-Intelligence/openpi A few months ago we announced π 0 , our first general-purpose robotic foundation model that could be fine-tuned to a diverse range of tasks (folding laundry, cleaning a table, scooping coffee beans, etc) and that could control a variety of different robot type (robots with two arms, single-arm platforms, mobile robots, etc). Today, we are releasing the code and weights for the π 0 as part of our experimental openpi repository. Our aim with this release is to enable anyone to experiment with fine-tuning π 0 to their own robots and tasks.
